intro: Philmor's Favor is a delivery task in Stormwind prompted by an ongoing shortage of local dockhands. Couriers are asked to transport a delicate Gatehouse shipment to a secluded stockroom entrance situated on the second floor of Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Every day this week we've been short dockhands.
Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
